thread:
riley: Quick sync  opening a small quickstart refresh PR to: switch examples to ephemeral token flow, add a one-file docker-compose first-deploy, and make model selection explicit. Drafting now; will push in ~20m. Can someone take a short snippet check?

neha: Happy to check copy and links. Which SDK version are we targeting?

riley: @redwood/inference v1.10.0 so we can use client.auth.getEphemeralToken.

link-bot: scan-report: found 1 broken link in current quickstart => https://old.docs.redwood.inference/auth/env-vars (404)

todd: For compose: keep it minimal. single node service, mount repo, run npm install && npm start. Add a tiny M1 note to recommend node:18-bullseye-slim.

riley: Good. Draft auth snippet I'm planning:
export RW_API_KEY=sk.test_ABC
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const server = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const ephemeral = await server.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttlSeconds: 300 });
// client uses ephemeral.token for short-lived calls

neha: tiny nit: mention refreshing tokens before reuse and call out server vs client responsibility. I'll review copy when you open the PR.

todd: Also explicitly set model: 'rw/gtr-mini-v1' in generate() examples to avoid default changes.

riley: Will include those. Planned reviewers: neha (copy/links), todd (compose + M1), sam (sanity check of examples). I'll tag you all in the draft PR and run docs-linkcheck in CI.

sam: I'll validate the example runs locally tonight. :+1:

riley: Thanks team  posting PR link here when ready. :shipit:
